title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers

claims.claim: Anthropic modelleri, bir yıl öncesine göre kabaca iki kat daha hızlı gelişiyor.

evidence.quote: with the company’s models improving roughly twice as quickly as a year ago
One of METR’s most noteworthy findings is that Anthropic’s AI models are improving roughly twice as quickly as they were a year ago

claims.claim: AI safety research organization METR published a report on Thursday following an 11-week investigation inside Anthropic.

evidence.quote: That’s according to a new report published Thursday by the AI safety research organization METR, following an 11-week investigation inside the company

claims.claim: Anthropic employees using the company's most capable internal model self-reported being around 12 times as productive at their work.

evidence.quote: METR wrote that employees using Anthropic’s most capable internal model on average self-reported being around 12 times as productive at their respective work as they would have been without AI assistance
METR wrote that employees using Anthropic’s most capable internal model on average self-reported being around 12 times as productive at their work as they would have been without AI assistance

claims.claim: Anthropic has finished training three unreleased models codenamed Model 2, Model 3, and Model 4 over the past six months.

evidence.quote: Over the past six months, Anthropic has finished training three models it has yet to release, according to METR. The pace of development is swift, with the models — codenamed Model 2, Model 3, and Model 4 — completing training in July, August-September, and September-October, respectively.

claims.claim: METR identified an unreleased Anthropic model dating back to 2022 called Unreleased 2022.

evidence.quote: METR also identified an unreleased model dating back to 2022, called Unreleased 2022.

claims.claim: Anthropic redacted a majority of the evidence found most informative in the public version of METR's report.

evidence.quote: “For the public version, Anthropic redacted a majority of the evidence we found most informative,” METR wrote on X.
“We submitted a ~100-page full report on our assessment to Anthropic. For the public version, Anthropic redacted a majority of the evidence we found most informative,” METR wrote on X.

claims.claim: OpenAI stated in September that it is making strong progress toward building an AI researcher by March 2028.
Anthropic cofounder Sam McCandlish stated that the company plans to publish its own report on the speed of AI progress in the coming weeks.

evidence.quote: He said the company plans to publish its own report on the speed of AI progress “in the coming weeks,” as well as new steps it’s taking to strengthen safety.
